Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unanimous **(सर्वसम्मत): Fully in agreement.

 
 
• **Example:** The committee reached a **unanimous **decision.
 
 
 
• **Millennium **(सहस्राब्दी): A period of a thousand years.
 
 
• **Example: **We celebrated the start of the new **millennium **in 2000.
 
 
 
• **Inconvenience** (असुविधा): Trouble or difficulty caused to one's personal comfort.
 
 
• **Example:** We apologize for the **inconvenience **caused by the delay.
